what: Run 2: a low-prior copy fine-tune (E147's key copy task on its lowest-prior windows, prior at least 1.5 decades under key copy's, near cipher's) x3 seeds at E237's common update size, a matched Gaussian random update per seed, the head (2,4) switch-off on the new states, then every proxy on the four corners of prior (high/low) x mechanism (through the copy head or not): copy (high, reused), prior_cipher (high, new), low-prior copy (low, reused), cipher (low, new); rank1 and elicit read beside them. Run 1 (predictions.json) must have finished: its labels are the mechanism axis for the three saved corners.

settings.source_task_source: E147's copy map (experiments/refit_96key/results/inventory.json maps.copy): its 96 keys, marker 18214, identity table and its train/held-out counts (1214, 286) as the caps
settings.seeds_source: E147's seeds, passed to keydep.finetune as E147 passed them
settings.prior_bar_source: whip-lead 2026-11-21: the answer's prior at least 1.5 decades under key copy's: 10^(log10 5.9107e-5 - 1.5) = 10^-5.7284 (key copy's log10 prior -4.2284, experiments/key_grid/results/summary.json log10_prior; cipher's -5.8595 sits 0.13 decades under the bar)
settings.n_pool_source: chosen here for row count, not for any reading: about 208 windows a key before the selection (E58 drew 500 per 32 keys, 15.6 a key). If M's log P(x) has a spread of about 2 nats across windows, a run 1.5 decades (3.45 nats) under the mean keeps about a tenth: ~1600 train and ~400 read rows before the caps. The construction check stops the job if the rows fall short
settings.pool_seed_source: new (kv.windows' seed). The selection (lowest_run) has no randomness: the run, thinned evenly in sorted order to E147's count, then that set's own run, so its mean stays at or under the bar
settings.mins_source: chosen here: four of E58's batches of 64 to train on; 64 read rows (E62 read 200, E147 286); half of the 96 keys kept in training. Under any of these the construction check stops the job before training
settings.step_source: E147's and E237's step (every key state is the step-30 update)
settings.random_seed_source: new; new state i's random direction uses random_seed + i (E237's construction, finetune.random_direction: a Gaussian per matrix at the state's own Frobenius norm, times the same c)
settings.split_tol_source: E228's and E237's split_tol (commute.split.bases' default), so r is read as E237 read it

thresholds.prior_repro_rel_source: E133's stage-0 tol_rel on this path (experiments/prior_vs_share/results/predictions.json stage0): the copy prior 5.9107e-5 must repeat
thresholds.share_tol_source: E187's share_tol for holes_fill's readers (experiments/size_matched/results/predictions.json): E147's saved neuron and steering shares on e58/copy_s0 must repeat at c = 1
thresholds.share_new_max_source: run 1's and E62's 'new' cut (copying.share_label); whip-lead: the low-prior copy must lose at least 0.2 of its gain with (2,4) off to count as reused

measurement: Corner value per proxy = mean over the three seeds. head_share: run 1's share lost with (2,4) off (copying.share_lost). r: the re-gating share, log-odds form (E228.readings, E237's call; the key states' are E237's saved stage1 'scaled' r). log10_prior: M's geometric-mean P(answer) on the read rows (E133's forward_prior; the key tasks' are E237's summary log10_prior). size: E187's ||dW||/||W0||. erank: update_spectrum.state. steering_pooled, steering_perkey, neuron_k64, neuron_kmatched: holes_fill's Job.state (E143's fair steering and TopK neurons, as E147 and E187 read them), each update times its task's c. Effects per proxy: mechanism = ((copy + lowcopy) - (prior_cipher + cipher)) / 2, prior = ((copy + prior_cipher) - (lowcopy + cipher)) / 2. Band = the largest seed range (max - min over seeds) of that proxy over the four corners, this job.

rules.construction: before training: the kept read rows' prior (E133's path) <= prior_bar, >= n_train_min train and n_read_min read rows, >= n_keys_min keys in training; else exit 1
rules.Q0_lowcopy_uses_head: the new states' mean head share >= 0.2 and every seed's share > its median random-head share (run 1's verdict function); 'not_read' unless every seed is readable
rules.corners_labelled: the 2x2 is read only when Q0 holds and run 1's P1 (copy) and P2 (both ciphers) hold; otherwise every Q below reads 'not_read'
rules.follows: per proxy: 'mechanism' iff |mechanism effect| > |prior effect| and > band; 'prior' iff |prior effect| > |mechanism effect| and > band; 'no_call' otherwise (ties included); 'not_read' if a corner is not finite
rules.Q2_prior_follows_prior: the prior proxy's call (by construction 'prior'; a check that the corners are built as meant)
rules.Q4_neurons_follow: TopK neuron shares' calls (k64, k matched)

edge_cases.zero_band: the prior proxy has no seed spread (band 0): any effect over 0 counts; size's effects are ~0 by construction, so it reads no_call unless the scaling misses
edge_cases.nan_share: steering and neuron shares are nan under holes_fill's gain floor (the random updates): a corner with a nan seed is 'not_read' for that proxy
edge_cases.too_few_rows: the construction check stops the job; the selection is then reported as the result and nothing is trained
edge_cases.lowcopy_not_reused: Q0 misses: no 2x2 call; the proxies are still written for the record

expected.construction: log10 prior ~-5.75 (just under the bar -5.73; the thinning keeps the whole run's spread, so the kept prior sits near the bar), ~1214 train and ~286 read rows (the caps), 80-96 keys
expected.Q0: head share ~0.25, key copy's in run 1 (E249 read 0.248, 'between', experiments/prior_mech_2x2/results/stage1/summary.json; null floor 0.074). Same task, same mechanism, harder rows. Near the 0.2 bar: a miss is plausible, and it stops the 2x2 call
expected.values_at_M_and_controls: random updates: gain ~0 (E237's read -0.015 to 0.010), so head share 'too_small', r nan, steering and neuron shares nan; the do-nothing is run 1's control (zero update reads F = M exactly)
expected.Q1: mechanism: r copy 0.771, prior_cipher 0.368, cipher 0.272 (E237); lowcopy ~0.7. Mechanism effect ~0.41, prior effect ~0.08, band ~0.03. Rival (r follows the prior): lowcopy ~0.3, prior effect ~0.28 against a mechanism effect ~0.21
expected.Q2: prior: log10 copy -4.23, prior_cipher -4.43, lowcopy ~-5.75, cipher -5.86; prior effect ~1.4, mechanism effect ~0.15
expected.Q3: pooled steering: mechanism if copy's 'turn copying on' direction still works on hard rows (copy 0.74 vs prior_cipher 0.14 at saved size, E147 stage1); the user's rival (cheap readings follow the prior) predicts lowcopy near cipher's 0.16. Filed expectation: no strong one; this is the cell where steering and r can come apart. Per-key steering: no_call (0.90-1.00 on every key task, E147)
expected.Q4: no_call: every key task's TopK share is under 0.03 (E147 stage1), within a few hundredths of 0
expected.size: no_call by construction (every corner at E237's common size)
expected.erank: no expectation filed: copy 475 vs prior_cipher 407 and cipher 405 (E237); lowcopy unknown

blind_to: Mechanism is 'through copy head (2,4) or not', read by one ablation; a corner whose copy runs through other heads is mislabelled. The low-prior corner is a selection of the copy task's rows, not a new task: it lowers M's prior on the answer while keeping the task's form. The proxies' calls compare two effects of the same proxy, so units cancel, but a proxy with large seed spread gets a wide band and reads no_call.
positive_control: run 1's control (M's copying falls under (2,4) off); here the prior path and holes_fill's readers repeat their saved readings before any selection
stop_rules: prior repeat off by more than prior_repro_rel
a holes_fill repeat off by more than share_tol
